caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of sub-dimensions and evaluation perplexity (PPL) for two different models. The x-axis is labeled "Numbers of Sub-Dims" and has a linear scale ranging from 16 to 256, with tick labels at intervals of 1632, 64, 128, and 256. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and has a linear scale ranging from 9.5 to 12.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. 

A dashed red line, representing "Transformer", begins at approximately 11.6 at a sub-dimension number of 1632 and remains relatively constant at approximately 11.6 across the x-axis, concluding at 11.6 at a sub-dimension number of 256. A solid blue line with triangular markers, representing "MoHD", starts at approximately 10.5 at a sub-dimension number of 1632, increases to approximately 10.7 at a sub-dimension number of 64, plateaus at approximately 10.7 until a sub-dimension number of 128, and then decreases to approximately 10.6 at a sub-dimension number of 256.
